title: OmniGuard SOC Telemetry & Graph Schemas
description: Standardized data schemas for VerifyEye (ingress phishing), SpectraC2 (beaconing egress), and Neo4j graph entity correlation.

VerifyEyeAlert.description: Alert payload emitted by VerifyEye Chrome Extension / Ingress crawler when phishing or brand impersonation is detected.

timestamp.description: Epoch timestamp (seconds with microsecond precision) of detection

host_id.description: Unique identifier / hostname of endpoint device (Host node in Neo4j)

user.description: Logged-in user account identifier, if available (User node in Neo4j)

src_ip.description: Local / egress IP address of the client machine

target_url.description: Full URL of the flagged phishing website

domain.description: Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN) being visited (Domain node in Neo4j)

action_endpoint.description: Form action URL where intercepted credentials would be submitted

brand_target.description: Corporate brand identified by YOLOv8/pHash (e.g., 'Microsoft 365', 'Okta', 'Google Workspace')

confidence.description: Object detection model confidence score (0.0 to 1.0)

phash_distance.description: Hamming distance of visual perceptual hash against authentic brand template

input_frozen.description: Whether client-side script successfully locked input fields and blocked form submission

mitre_technique.description: Mapped MITRE ATT&CK technique code (e.g. T1566.002 Spearphishing Link, T1056 Input Capture)

raw_metadata.description: Optional telemetry details (DOM tree signature, bounding box coordinates, TLS certificate issuer)

SpectraC2Alert.description: Alert payload emitted by SpectraC2 beacon detector on encrypted network traffic.

beacon_interval.description: Dominant periodicity in seconds computed via FFT power spectral density

neo4j_graph_schema.description: Graph topology model for Neo4j entity resolution, shortest path discovery, and blast radius calculation.

relationships.description: Host queried DNS for this external domain
Network flow observed between host and target IP
User logged in or authenticated on host
IP address serves the specified domain
Direct link from incoming security alert to affected Host
Link from phishing or C2 alert to malicious domain
Link from network alert to malicious or destination IP
Link from alert to victim or compromised account

create_constraints: CREATE CONSTRAINT IF NOT EXISTS FOR (h:Host) REQUIRE h.host_id IS UNIQUE;
CREATE CONSTRAINT IF NOT EXISTS FOR (u:User) REQUIRE u.username IS UNIQUE;
CREATE CONSTRAINT IF NOT EXISTS FOR (i:IP) REQUIRE i.address IS UNIQUE;
CREATE CONSTRAINT IF NOT EXISTS FOR (d:Domain) REQUIRE d.domain_name IS UNIQUE;
CREATE CONSTRAINT IF NOT EXISTS FOR (a:Alert) REQUIRE a.alert_id IS UNIQUE;
sample_cypher_queries.ingest_verifyeye_alert:
MERGE (a:Alert {alert_id: $alert_id})
ON CREATE SET a.source = $source,
              a.event_type = $event_type,
              a.severity = $severity,
              a.confidence = $confidence,
              a.mitre_technique = $mitre_technique,
              a.timestamp = $timestamp,
              a.status = 'new',
              a.description = $description
MERGE (h:Host {host_id: $host_id})
ON CREATE SET h.hostname = $host_id, h.status = 'ACTIVE'
MERGE (a)-[:TARGETS_HOST]->(h)

FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN $user IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    MERGE (u:User {username: $user})
    MERGE (a)-[:INVOLVES_USER]->(u)
    MERGE (u)-[:LOGGED_INTO {timestamp: $timestamp}]->(h)
)

FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN $domain IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    MERGE (d:Domain {domain_name: $domain})
    ON CREATE SET d.brand_impersonated = $brand_target,
                  d.reputation_score = 0.95,
                  d.is_sinkholed = false
    MERGE (a)-[:INDICATES_DOMAIN]->(d)
    MERGE (h)-[:RESOLVED_DOMAIN {timestamp: $timestamp}]->(d)
)

FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN $src_ip IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    MERGE (i:IP {address: $src_ip})
    MERGE (h)-[:HAS_IP]->(i)
);
sample_cypher_queries.ingest_spectrac2_alert:
MERGE (a:Alert {alert_id: $alert_id})
ON CREATE SET a.source = $source,
              a.event_type = $event_type,
              a.severity = $severity,
              a.confidence = $confidence,
              a.mitre_technique = $mitre_technique,
              a.timestamp = $timestamp,
              a.status = 'new',
              a.description = 'Periodic C2 beaconing detected via FFT/LSTM spectral inference'
MERGE (src_host:Host {host_id: $host_id})
ON CREATE SET src_host.status = 'ACTIVE'
MERGE (a)-[:TARGETS_HOST]->(src_host)

MERGE (dst_ip:IP {address: $dst_ip})
ON CREATE SET dst_ip.is_internal = false
MERGE (a)-[:INDICATES_IP]->(dst_ip)

MERGE (src_host)-[r:COMMUNICATED_WITH {port: $dst_port, proto: $proto}]->(dst_ip)
SET r.beacon_interval = $beacon_interval,
    r.mean_jitter = $mean_jitter,
    r.timestamp = $timestamp

FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN $sni IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    MERGE (d:Domain {domain_name: $sni})
    MERGE (a)-[:INDICATES_DOMAIN]->(d)
    MERGE (dst_ip)-[:HOSTS_DOMAIN]->(d)
    MERGE (src_host)-[:RESOLVED_DOMAIN {timestamp: $timestamp}]->(d)
);

verifyeye_payload.description: VerifyEye intercepted zero-hour credential theft page visually impersonating Microsoft 365. Keystroke inputs frozen.
